terminal_name: Brazil small-scale liquefaction (Eneva Parnaiba; Petrobras/Amazonica Urucu)
issue: Discovery sweep surfaced two domestic small-scale LNG liquefaction operations NOT in GEM, both judged below GEM terminal scope (small-scale distribution / truck-loading, not import/export marine terminals): (1) Eneva's Parnaiba liquefaction plant at Santo Antonio dos Lopes, Maranhao - two trains, combined ~600,000 cbm/yr (~0.27 MTPA-equiv), unit 1 online Dec 2024, unit 2 commercial Feb 2025, supplies trucks/industrial via Parnaiba-basin gas; (2) Petrobras + Amazonica Energy small-scale LNG commercialization from the Urucu Cluster (Amazonas), first contract signed, gas supply slated to start Feb 2028. Neither is a regasification/import or large-scale export terminal; flagging only so a reviewer can confirm GEM's scale-threshold call rather than treat them as missed terminals.
suggested_action: Confirm against methodology that small-scale truck-loading liquefaction (no marine LNG carrier loading) is out of GEM terminal scope; if a scale/scope reading would include them, route to a future Discovery add. Otherwise no action.

terminal_name: Brazil regas pipeline (EPE Plano Indicativo / Novo PAC)
issue: Cross-checked the EPE 'Plano Indicativo de Terminais de GNL' four-priority list (Itacoatiara AM, Sao Luis MA, Presidente Kennedy ES, Pontal do Parana PR) and the Novo PAC inclusions (Suape regas, Barcarena/CELBA) against GEM: ALL map to existing GEM rows (Itacoatiara FSRU T100000130931; TGNL Sao Luis FSRU T100001054266; Presidente Kennedy FSRU T100000130934; Parana FSRU T100000130932; Suape FSRU T100000130936; New Fortress Barcarena FSRU T100000130926). 'Terminal Portuario Brites' (Triunfo, Novo PAC) is a general port terminal, not an LNG facility - not a lead. Buzios ssm-FLNG export concept is an academic economic-assessment paper only (no sponsor commitment / concrete step) - below threshold, not staged. No genuine GEM coverage gap found for Brazil this round.
suggested_action: No action; coverage confirmed comprehensive and current for Brazil.
